contents.name: Snapshot
contents.description: Point-in-time health readings taken at tick time.

fields.name: EnrollmentCertificatesExist
fields.description: States if enrollment certificates available with the agent.

fields.name: IsSourceMqttClientHealthy
fields.description: Is internal health of the Source-side MQTT client in Agent healthy.

fields.name: IsNodeMqttClientHealthy
fields.description: Is internal health of the Node-side MQTT client in Agent healthy.

fields.name: IsInInitialConfiguration
fields.description: States if the agent is still running its initial, unconfigured twin graph and has not yet received a source/stream configuration from the cloud.

contents.name: Windowed
contents.description: Windowed health observations accumulated since the last health tick.

fields.name: TwinWasClearedDueToEnrollmentFailureCount
fields.displayName: Twin Cleared Due To Enrollment Failure Count
fields.description: Number of times the twin was cleared due to enrollment failure since the last health tick.

fields.name: AgeLimitHitStreams
fields.description: Streams for which the merkle tree age hit limit instead of depth.

fields.name: SourceBrokerDisconnectionCount
fields.description: Number of times the agent was disconnected from the source broker since the last health tick.

fields.name: NodeBrokerDisconnectionCount
fields.description: Number of times the agent was disconnected from the node/cloud broker since the last health tick.

fields.name: SourceMqttClientWasUnhealthyCount
fields.displayName: Source MQTT Client Was Unhealthy Count
fields.description: Number of times the Source-side MQTT client in Agent was unhealthy since the last health tick.

fields.name: NodeMqttClientWasUnhealthyCount
fields.displayName: Node MQTT Client Was Unhealthy Count
fields.description: Number of times the Node-side MQTT client in Agent was unhealthy since the last health tick.

fields.name: DlqFullCount
fields.description: Number of times the DLQ reached full capacity since the last health tick.
